description: This file defines a React component for rendering and managing column headers in a data table, including drag-and-drop reordering, sorting, filtering, and lock/unlock functionality for the first column.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: A React component that provides filtering UI for table columns based on data types and content.

methods.name: reorderColumn
methods.description: Reorders columns in the column order array based on drag-and-drop interaction.

methods.name: DraggableColumnHeader
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a table column header with drag-and-drop, sorting, filtering, and lock functionalities.
